tagline: 爱克发数码单反相机，1980 年发布
description: 爱克发于1980年推出的数码单反相机。使用Single stroke in an arc of 130° with 25° stand off. Coupling for motorized film advance with Chinon Power Winder. Multiple Exposure switch disengages film advance and frame counter.。感光度25 to 3200 ASA.。

specs.曝光测光: Auto aperture priority, or match-the-LED manual exposure (where the camera suggested speed LED is lit, and the user selected speed flashes).
specs.胶片/画幅: Single stroke in an arc of 130° with 25° stand off. Coupling for motorized film advance with Chinon Power Winder. Multiple Exposure switch disengages film advance and frame counter.
specs.电池: Three 1.5V Alkaline batteries (LR44) or 1.5V silver oxide batteries (SR44). Battery test with LED indicator.
specs.英文简介: Three Selectronic SLRs featuring the K mount were introduced in 1980.
